en.field.autoMaxModelCallsPerSession.help: Maximum cumulative model calls allowed for all automatic reviews across the entire session.
en.field.autoMaxModelCallsPerSession.title: Model Call Budget per Session
en.field.autoMaxModelCallsPerSession.warnBu: Current session budget ({current} calls) is below the worst-case requirement ({required} calls) for {judges} judge(s). Consider increasing it to avoid premature budget exhaustion.
en.field.autoMaxModelCallsPerTask.help: Maximum model calls shared across all automatic review stages (routing, comparison, final acceptance) per task.
en.field.autoMaxModelCallsPerTask.title: Model Call Budget per Task
en.field.autoMaxModelCallsPerTask.warnBudge: Current task budget ({current} calls) is below the worst-case requirement ({required} calls) for {judges} judge(s) in a full tournament. Consider increasing it to avoid premature budget exhaustion.
en.field.autoPriceFromCatalog.help: Automatically retrieves token prices from the local pi-ai model catalog. Manually entered prices take priority.
en.field.autoPriceFromCatalog.title: Auto Price From Catalog
en.field.autoPriceOnline.help: When missing locally, queries the online models.dev database for exact price matching (cached for 24 hours).
en.field.autoPriceOnline.title: Online Price Lookup
en.field.autoProcessAlternativeModel.help: Comma-separated list of provider/model routes used to generate the candidates. Candidate i uses entry i, wrapping around when the list is shorter. Leave empty to resample with the session model.
en.field.autoProcessAlternativeModel.title: Generate the alternative with another model
en.field.autoProcessCandidates.help: Total candidates generated for process selection (including original, default 2). 3 or 4 runs a tournament and uses more calls.
en.field.autoProcessCandidates.title: Process-selection candidates
en.field.autoProcessFailureContext.help: Attaches error logs from the two failed runs to the alternative request to encourage a different troubleshooting approach.
en.field.autoProcessFailureContext.title: Give the alternative the failure evidence
en.field.autoProcessSelection.everyStepWarn: "Every step" generates N-1 alternatives and judges every one of them on each step, so cost and latency rise sharply. Configure a judge that returns logprobs (DeepSeek official, or an OpenAI-compatible logprobs service): otherwise the single-letter jitter of the explicit-tag channel is amplified.
en.field.autoProcessSelection.help: Off (default): never touches the main loop; Recovery: fires once after two consecutive failed verification runs (the original behaviour); Every step: generates and judges alternatives on every main-loop request, bounded by the per-task cycle ceiling.
en.field.autoProcessSelection.title: Process Selection (Controlled)
en.field.autoRouteMaxCandidates.help: Maximum number of candidate options evaluated in a single candidate selection (3–16).
en.field.autoRouteMaxCandidates.title: Max Candidates
en.field.autoRouteMaxInputChars.help: Total sanitized character budget across all candidates and steps in a single route review.
en.field.autoRouteMaxInputChars.title: Total Route Input Chars Cap
en.field.autoRouteMaxItemChars.help: Maximum sanitized characters allowed for a single candidate or step in a route review.
en.field.autoRouteMaxItemChars.title: Max Chars per Route Item
en.field.autoRouteMaxPerSession.help: Maximum automatic routing attempts allowed across the entire session.
en.field.autoRouteMaxPerSession.title: Max Routes per Session
en.field.autoRouteMaxPerTask.help: Maximum automatic comparison and progress tracking attempts per task (counted separately from final acceptance).
en.field.autoRouteMaxPerTask.title: Max Routes per Task
en.field.autoRouteMinConfidence.help: Minimum confidence (0–1, 0.9 recommended) required for semantic routing before triggering reviews.
en.field.autoRouteMinConfidence.title: Semantic Route Confidence
en.field.autoRouteSemantic.help: When explicit clues are absent, the judge model analyzes context to identify targets for candidate comparison or progress tracking.
en.field.autoRouteSemantic.title: Hybrid Semantic Routing
en.field.autoTrackCompletionThreshold.help: Progress checkpoint threshold (0–1). When the latest progress is below this value, the Agent is prompted to continue.
en.field.autoTrackCompletionThreshold.title: Progress Completion Threshold
en.field.autoTrackRepeats.help: Number of scoring rounds for progress tracking (default 3). Averaging multiple rounds reduces sampling noise.
en.field.autoTrackRepeats.title: Progress Repeats
en.field.autoVerify.warnNotice: Automatic review follows the sequence: candidate selection → comparison → progress tracking → final acceptance. Sanitized task info, trajectories, and tool outputs are sent to the judge; insufficient progress prompts continuation, and failed acceptance requires remediation.
en.field.autoVerifyFinalRepeats.help: Scoring rounds per criterion for final acceptance (default 2). Even rounds swap A/B positions to cancel position bias.
en.field.autoVerifyFinalRepeats.title: Final Acceptance Repeats
en.field.autoVerifyMaxChars.help: Maximum recent session trajectory characters retained and sent to the judge for final acceptance.
en.field.autoVerifyMaxChars.title: Max Evidence Characters
en.field.autoVerifyMaxPerSession.help: Maximum final acceptance attempts allowed across the entire session.
en.field.autoVerifyMaxPerSession.title: Max Verifications per Session
en.field.autoVerifyMaxPerTask.help: Maximum final acceptance attempts per task (counted separately to prevent infinite remediation loops).
en.field.autoVerifyMaxPerTask.title: Max Verifications per Task
en.field.autoVerifyMinToolCalls.help: Minimum non-Verifier tool calls required to trigger smart acceptance (must include consequential actions and success).
en.field.autoVerifyMinToolCalls.title: Min Tool Calls (Smart Mode)
en.field.autoVerifyMode.help: Manual: explicit calls only; Smart (recommended): automatically reviews and gates when sufficient evidence is present; Strict: enforces full review and acceptance after any consequential action.
en.field.autoVerifyMode.title: Invocation Policy
en.field.autoVerifyPlanMode.help: Automatically pre-verifies plan feasibility and risks before exit_plan_mode submits the plan for user review.
en.field.autoVerifyPlanMode.title: Plan Mode Pre-verification
en.field.autoVerifyRepeats.help: Scoring repeats per criterion for candidate comparison (default 1, higher values increase stability).
en.field.autoVerifyRepeats.title: Routing Repeats
en.field.autoVerifySubagents.help: Whether to also run automatic routing and acceptance on delegated child sessions. Consumes additional judge budget.
en.field.autoVerifySubagents.title: Verify Subagent Sessions
en.field.autoVerifyTeamTasks.help: Automatically routes progress tracking and acceptance when Agent Teams tasks change status or complete.
en.field.autoVerifyTeamTasks.title: Verify Team Tasks
en.field.autoVerifyThreshold.help: Minimum score (0–1) required to pass final acceptance. Agent will be prompted to remediate if below this score.
en.field.autoVerifyThreshold.title: Pass Threshold
en.field.autoWorkspaceEvidence.help: Whether session acceptance (the explicit verifier_current_session tool and the automatic final gate) carries the host's own record of what this turn changed on disk: the changed-file list with added/deleted counts, plus a per-file before/after comparison. The evidence comes from the host observing the workspace rather than from the agent's own account, is bounded by the per-item and combined character caps, and any read failure degrades silently to no evidence. Requires a DSH 0.1.6+ host; older hosts ignore this setting.
en.field.autoWorkspaceEvidence.title: Attach real file-change evidence
en.field.cacheDir.help: Relative directory path for persistent score cache (relative to topic directory).
en.field.cacheDir.title: Cache Relative Directory
en.field.cacheMaxEntries.help: Maximum entries retained in the local persistent score cache before pruning oldest records.
en.field.cacheMaxEntries.title: Max Cache Entries
en.field.captureDecisions.help: Saves sanitized prompts and raw outputs of judge calls in the topic directory for dashboard tracing.
en.field.captureDecisions.title: Keep decision snapshots
en.field.criteriaFile.help: Path to a custom Markdown rubric file. Automatically falls back to the default "coding" rubric on failure. Increase model call budget if defining more than 3 criteria.
en.field.criteriaFile.title: Criteria File
en.field.criteriaPreset.help: Evaluation rubric preset for automatic review and final acceptance. Different presets tailor to different tasks.
en.field.criteriaPreset.sampleA: (sample trajectory A) Ran pytest -k login: 1 failed … changed auth.py … ran it again: 1 passed.
en.field.criteriaPreset.sampleB: (sample trajectory B) Already fixed it, should be fine.
en.field.criteriaPreset.sampleTask: (sample task) Fix the login endpoint returning 500.
en.field.criteriaPreset.title: Acceptance Rubric
en.field.enabled.helpOff: When disabled, all Verifier tools will be unavailable and return an error.
en.field.enabled.helpOn: Allows the Agent to call Verifier tools and send review requests to the judge model.
en.field.enabled.title: Enable Verifier Tools
en.field.enabled.warnDisabled: verifier_compare, verifier_select, verifier_track, verifier_best_of_n, and verifier_current_session are currently unavailable.

en.field.estimatedOutputUsdPerMillion.title: Output Price

en.field.extraJudges.title: Extra Judges
en.field.label.help: Custom display name for the judge in dashboards and records. Defaults to the model name.
en.field.label.title: Judge Label
en.field.maxConcurrency.help: Maximum concurrent requests shared across all Verifier reviews.
en.field.maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
en.field.maxProcessCyclesPerTask.help: Only the "Every step" arm reads this: how many process-selection cycles one task may buy (1-32, default 4). This allowance is independent of the routing quota and of the final-acceptance quota.
en.field.maxProcessCyclesPerTask.title: Process cycles per task
en.field.maxRetries.help: Maximum retry attempts on rate limits, timeouts, or transient network errors.
en.field.maxRetries.title: Max Retries
en.field.maxTokens.help: Maximum output tokens allowed in a single judge completion.
en.field.maxTokens.title: Max Output Tokens
en.field.model.help: Specific model to serve as the independent judge.
en.field.model.title: Model
en.field.priceProviderOverride.help: For unlisted reseller or aggregator routes, specify a reference provider ID (e.g. openrouter) to convert pricing.
en.field.priceProviderOverride.title: Price Source Provider
en.field.provider.help: Model provider of the judge (must be configured in DSH "Models").
en.field.provider.title: Provider
en.field.reasoningEffort.help: Reasoning effort level (low / medium / high). Leave empty to use model default.
en.field.reasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Effort
en.field.retryBaseDelayMs.help: Base backoff wait time (ms) before retrying network errors.
en.field.retryBaseDelayMs.title: Retry Base Delay
en.field.temperature.help: Sampling temperature for judge calls (0–2). Lower values (e.g. 0.2) improve verdict consistency and stability.
en.field.temperature.title: Judge Sampling Temperature
en.field.timeoutMs.help: Timeout duration (ms) for a single judge model request.
en.field.timeoutMs.title: Request Timeout
